method: Headless Chromium (Playwright 1.56 bundled build), 390x844 CSS px, DPR 2, touch + mobile emulation, reduced motion. For every visible interactive element: scroll it to the viewport centre, then walk 1px steps left/right/up/down from its centre while document.elementFromPoint() still returns the control or a descendant (cap 60px each way, so 121 means 'at least 121'). 'covered' means another element owns the centre point. Guide scaffolding (guide chips, specimen controls) and sr-only radios are excluded. Scenario syntax: route|selector clicked|selector clicked.
